channel.title: Downtown & South Lake Union Dispatch
channel.description: Downtown & South Lake Union news, once a week, from the Downtown & South Lake Union Dispatch.

item.title: Buses run a Sunday schedule today, and the South Lake Union Streetcar sits out
item.description: Metro buses run their Sunday schedule today and a regular weekday schedule Friday.

item.title: The city's commercial parking tax goes from 14.5% to 17% on January 1
item.description: The Council passed the increase on November 20, the same day it passed the 2027 budget.

item.title: The Monorail's fare ceiling rises from $4 to $7
item.description: Also on November 20, the Council let Seattle Center amend the Monorail's operating agreement so a one-way adult fare may go as high as $7, and a discounted fare as high as $3.50.

item.title: the holiday pickup shift
item.description: Seattle Public Utilities does not collect garbage, recycling or food and yard waste today.

item.title: Westlake Park lights its holiday tree Friday, November 27, at 5 PM, with fireworks right after
item.description: The Downtown Seattle Association's free celebration starts at 11 AM in the park, with crafts and costumed characters before the lighting.

item.title: Pike Place is open to cars Monday to Thursday this winter, and closes to them on Saturday, November 28
item.description: The Market's winter schedule runs from October 1 to March 31: Monday through Thursday the street is open to traffic, and drivers must yield to people walking; Friday through Sunday, 11 AM to 4 PM, only authorized vehicles may enter.

item.title: A 271-seat chamber music hall has its permit at Sixth and Union
item.description: On October 19 the city issued the permit to change part of 1405 Sixth Avenue from medical services to a concert hall for the Seattle Chamber Music Society, $4.38 million of interior work in suite 305.

item.title: food scraps in a small kitchen
item.description: In Seattle, food waste and recyclables are not allowed in the garbage (SMC 21.36.082-083), and that holds in apartments and condos too.

item.title: What's opening in the small storefront at the southeast corner of First Avenue and Lenora Street
item.description: A reader asked what's opening in the small storefront at the southeast corner of First Avenue and Lenora Street.
